status: RESEARCH_DECISION: not an operational decoder, not a FLEXPART 11.1 parity result

decision.scope: ICON-EU deterministic regular-lat-lon GRIB2 as the FIRST operational #32 ingestion implementation under the current #29/#30/#31 contracts and pinned FLEXPART 11.1 oracle.
decision.reason: Every production consumer (advection, PBL/turbulence, convection, wet and dry deposition, settling) needs at least one field classified REQUIRES_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION or MISSING_SOURCE. The fields decodable as-is (surface state, terrain, land fraction, grid) drive no consumer on their own. Pinned FLEXPART 11.1 has no ICON reader (only readwind_ecmwf / readwind_gfs), so no pinned oracle consumes ICON input.
decision.recommended_first_provider: ERA5 via the existing ETEX/flex_extract-prepared validation path (#32 default)

classifications.SUPPORTED_AS_IS: Decoded source quantity, unit, sign, grid and time semantics equal the canonical field; no transformation.
classifications.SUPPORTED_WITH_PROVEN_TRANSFORMATION: An exact transformation is required and its correctness is shown by the cited evidence.
classifications.REQUIRES_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION: A plausible source exists, but equivalence or the transformation is unproven; owned by the cited blocker issue.
classifications.MISSING_SOURCE: The provider sample publishes no source for this field.
classifications.UNSUPPORTED: A provider quantity exists but must not be used for this canonical field.

source.product: ICON-EU deterministic forecast, regular latitude/longitude export (icon-eu_europe_regular-lat-lon)
source.model_identity_note: GRIB section 1 identifies DWD (centre 78), an operational forecast and generating process 2; the ICON-EU name itself appears only in the DWD directory/file name. Identity is therefore bound by centre + generating process + grid + vertical-grid UUID + SHA-256, never by the file name alone.

source.attribution: Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD), ICON-EU forecast 2026-10-31 00 UTC, https://opendata.dwd.de; raw messages redistributed unmodified

decoders.primary: ecCodes 2.24.2 (Debian libeccodes0 2.24.2-1, libaec0 1.0.6-1, python3-eccodes 1.4.0) in docker image flexpart-fortran:latest sha256:324bb63d7311b13d9700906f05c98babaa69967c1dbfed124abb135855f80d84
decoders.secondary: ecCodes 2.48.0 (Python eccodes 2.48.0 wheel, features AEC MEMFS JPG PNG), Windows
decoders.independent: scripts/provider/icon_eu_grib2_sections.py: WMO GRIB2 octet reader plus libaec 1.0.6 aec_buffer_decode, no ecCodes definitions
decoders.packing: GRIB2 data representation template 5.42 (CCSDS, grid_ccsds), 16 bits per value (0 for constant fields), ccsds flags 14, block size 32, RSI 128, no bitmap
decoders.codec_evidence: All 247 messages decode in the pinned ecCodes 2.24.2 container; decoded values are bit-identical to ecCodes 2.48.0 and to the independent libaec decode (max abs difference 0.0).
decoders.label_drift: ecCodes shortName/paramId/name/units and stepRange/stepUnits strings differ between 2.24.2 and 2.48.0 (e.g. SNOW_CON paramId 500052 vs 231057, stepRange '0-5040' minutes vs '0-84' hours). Provider identity must use raw GRIB2 octets (discipline/category/number, templates, surfaces, statistical processing), never ecCodes labels.
decoders.repository_rust_reader: src/io/grib2.rs is an ERA5 MVP (u/v/w/t/q, fixed level-set assumptions) and must not be reused for ICON-EU.

grid.meaning: Regular lat/lon, i east-fastest, j south-to-north (jScansPositively=1), cell-centred A-grid for every field; earth-relative winds (uvRelativeToGrid=0); spherical earth R=6371229 m. One identical grid in all 247 messages.
grid.transformation: longitude normalisation 336.5 deg -> -23.5 deg (subtract 360); no index reordering because canonical x_fastest storage with Y=0 at the southern row equals the GRIB scan order
grid.spacing_km: 0.0625 deg = 6.95 km north-south; east-west 6.02 km at 30 N, 4.47 km at 50 N, 2.38 km at 70 N
grid.effective_resolution: The export is interpolated by DWD from the native ICON-EU triangular grid (documented native spacing about 6.5 km). Effective meteorological resolution is not finer than the native grid and is not measured by this audit.

vertical.coordinate: ICON height-based terrain-following coordinate (GRIB2 typeOfFirstFixedSurface 150 generalVertical / generalVerticalLayer), not hybrid sigma-pressure
vertical.ordering: level 1 = model top, level 74 (full) / 75 (half) = lowest; heights strictly decrease with level index in every column
vertical.vertical_grid_identity: nlev=75, numberOfVGridUsed=4 and the UUID are identical in HHL and every model-level message (raw octets 4296000040800000f4e27f3af03da229299dca84d11c2e40)
vertical.staggering: U, V, T, QV, P, QC, QI, CLC on full levels 1-74 (layer between half levels k and k+1); W and TKE on half levels 1-75; HHL is the half-level geometric height above mean sea level
vertical.pressure: full-level pressure P supplied; no interface pressure and no hybrid A/B coefficients
vertical.canonical_compatibility: UNSUPPORTED by #29 schema v1 (GeometricHeight carries only a 1-D level profile) and by #30 (reconstruct_hybrid_pressure rejects non-hybrid coordinates).

time.time_unit: minutes (indicatorOfUnitOfTimeRange=0) for every message; a decoder that assumes hours mis-times every step by a factor of 60
time.accumulated: PDT 4.8, typeOfStatisticalProcessing=1, start at the run start (forecastTime=0), lengthOfTimeRange = 60 * step minutes; never reset within a run
time.averaged: PDT 4.8, typeOfStatisticalProcessing=0, average from the run start
time.static: time-invariant files carry the cycle reference time and forecastTime 0
time.cadence_intermediate_cycles: 03/09/15/21 UTC: 34 steps, hourly 0-30 h, then 36, 42, 48 h

operational_feasibility.workload: Europe, about 5-8 km, 48 h, 15 min simulation/output interval
operational_feasibility.input_cadence: hourly ICON-EU steps 0-48 from a 00/06/12/18 UTC cycle; a 15 min output interval does not require 15 min input, but the adequacy of hourly input is a per-process decision (#235 for precipitation, #233 for fluxes)
operational_feasibility.cycle_rule: one cycle per simulation; no file mixing across cycles; the simulation window must lie inside [initialization, initialization + 48 h] plus trailing precipitation interval

download_48h.basis: 2026-10-31 00 UTC listings, steps 0-48, U V W T QV P QC QI on all 74/75 levels plus 16 surface fields

operational_feasibility.spatial_subsetting: DWD publishes full-domain files only; download volume does not shrink with a subdomain, memory does

memory_estimate.note: f32, full domain, excluding particles, output grids and #184/#188 shared-height resources; scales linearly with the selected subdomain area

operational_feasibility.partial_download_rule: every required file of every required step must be present and match its manifest hash; a partial cycle fails closed
operational_feasibility.reproducibility: about 24 h retention on opendata.dwd.de; reproducible use requires archiving the bytes with their SHA-256 manifest

era5_comparison.icon_eu_role: future 48 h European forecast meteorology candidate (about 7 km)
era5_comparison.era5_role: established reproducible validation path: flex_extract-prepared ECMWF input consumed by pinned FLEXPART 11.1 (#30 real column oracle, #202/#207/#119/#211/#216/#219 chain, ETEX fixture)
era5_comparison.era5_limits: historical reanalysis, 0.25 deg, cannot supply future forecasts
era5_comparison.icon_eu_limits: no pinned FLEXPART reader or oracle; height-based coordinate; geometric W; averaged fluxes; GRIB2 CCSDS accumulations
era5_comparison.recommendation: Implement #32 first for ERA5/ETEX. Keep ICON-EU as a later provider adapter once #231-#235 are decided.

follow_up_boundaries.32-B: Canonical operational decoding: provider bytes -> complete validated #29 snapshots with provenance, first for ERA5/ETEX; for ICON-EU only the fields whose classification is SUPPORTED_* after #231-#235.
follow_up_boundaries.32-C: Provider-specific semantic adapters: only transformations approved by #231-#235 (ICON) or by existing decisions (ERA5), each with independent evidence and typed failures.
follow_up_boundaries.32-D: Production integration: real provider data through #30/#31/#76 into the supported production physics, without hand-injected meteorology.
